create.name: Mysore Room
create.bio:
Mysore Room is an Ashtanga yoga shala in Bangsar, Kuala Lumpur, founded by the husband-and-wife team Yan Ong and Manuel Ferreira, who met while assisting their teacher, the late R. Sharath Jois. Both hold Level 2 authorisation to teach Ashtanga: Manuel, who comes from Portugal, was authorised in 2009 and has taught since 2003, while Yan was authorised in 2012 and has taught in more than twelve countries. The studio honours the teaching that comes from the city of Mysore in southern India.

At its heart is the Mysore method, in which each student works through the Ashtanga sequence at their own pace while the teacher gives individual instruction and hands-on adjustment, so that newcomers and advanced practitioners share the same room. Weekly led classes take the whole group through the Primary Series in a Sanskrit count, and there are gentler beginner classes as well. Most classes are also streamed live for members who practise from home in other time zones.

Mysore Room hosts visiting senior Ashtanga teachers for multi-day workshops, runs weekend introductions for complete beginners, and offers an adjusting masterclass and apprenticeship for teachers who want to deepen their skills under its founders. Yan, Manuel and their small team of teachers are based at the studio throughout the year.

courses.title: Mysore Room memberships and class passes
courses.description: Unlimited monthly, prepaid and online-only memberships plus credit passes for Mysore-style, led Primary Series and beginner classes, in the studio in Bangsar or live online.
courses.price: monthly unlimited myr 800; digital online only myr 500; trial session myr 80; drop in myr 108; 10 credit pass myr 350

courses.title: David Robson & Jelena Vesic: 3 day Ashtanga Workshop in KL
courses.description: Three days with David Robson, who leads a large Mysore programme in Toronto, and Jelena Vesic: morning Mysore practice, a led Primary Series with a yoga talk, guided pranayama and meditation, and afternoon workshops on vinyasa and on forward folds and backbends.
courses.price: Early Bird MYR1125; Full Price MYR1400; Drop In Workshop MYR680; Drop in Practice MYR180

courses.title: Introduction to Ashtanga Yoga weekend
courses.description: A two-afternoon introduction for complete beginners with Manuel Ferreira: guided beginner practice, a first taste of Mysore-style self practice, and workshops on what Ashtanga is and how to remember the sequence.

courses.title: Kino MacGregor & Tim Feldmann: 4 day Ashtanga Workshop in KL
courses.description: Four days of Mysore-style practice, a led Primary Series with a talk, and weekend workshops on yoga anatomy, breathwork and long-term practice habits with two certified Ashtanga teachers.
courses.price: Early Bird MYR1500; Full Price MYR1800; Drop In Workshop MYR800; Drop in Practice MYR250
